method: Gas-free brine_props subset: modified Spivey, IAPWS-IF97 freshwater density, source brine viscosity
sourceSnapshot: Existing owner-authorized local pyrestoolbox-mcp environment; hashes identify actual files, not a claimed clean release
referenceExecution: Fresh existing local Python library executed via direct Node script with absolute interpreter and -B; no dependency installation

assumptions.salinity: NaCl weight percent, not mg/L TDS
assumptions.sourceDensityUnit: g/cm3 (specific-gravity-like numerical density); multiply by 1000 for kg/m3
assumptions.standardReference: 15 C, 0.1013 MPa freshwater; source saline standard integral uses 0.1015 MPa

scope: Educational single-phase gas-free aqueous brine; no hydraulics or capacity coupling
